openings.claim: Shared picking and repeated switching between pattern quantities may cause both crossed reaches and omissions. Small, pattern-specific batches with counted materials beside each volunteer could improve completeness and speed for participants and assemblers. This evaluates a bounded probe; meeting the complete 60-kit target remains unproven.
openings.delta: Replace individual picking from shared trays with two separate table lanes and limited local batches. Preserve each pattern's exact quantities and dimensions, pencil its identity on the envelope, and check contents before closing. Existing tags and samples remain reference aids.
openings.prediction: For comparable pattern mixtures, local staged batches will have fewer crossed reaches and missing items, with lower elapsed time including staging and checking. Exterior pattern marks will permit correct matching at distribution.
openings.rival_prediction: The twelve-kit result may reflect an easier pattern mixture or shorter-session attention rather than local staging. Matching the mixture will remove its advantage; omissions and time will remain similar even if crossed reaches decrease.
openings.defeat: A matched-mixture comparison showing unchanged or worse omissions and total time despite fewer crossed reaches would defeat the proposed causal benefit. Staging that cannot fit the table defeats this implementation.
openings.probe: Use the first twelve required kits as two comparable six-kit batches, one shared-tray and one locally staged; balance pattern counts and volunteer assignments where feasible. First verify both lanes fit inside the existing table. Count staging, picking, filling and immediate checks on the same 90-minute clock; tally crossed reaches and pre-correction omissions. Retain corrected kits for participants. Stop experimentation if it threatens completing the remaining required kits. A later full run would still be needed to establish 60 kits within 90 minutes and at most one distribution correction.
assumptions: The fit verdict concerns the bounded probe, with no table overflow, extra volunteers, purchases or time extension.
Comparable pattern mixtures can be formed from required kits; this is unconfirmed.
Local staging footprint and its full-run time benefit are unverified.
